Escape to the sun-drenched shores of Mykonos with every spritz. Mykonos Pink Beach captures the essence of Mediterranean romance — a delicate fusion of pink peppercorn, cyclamen, and creamy sandalwood that evokes lazy afternoons on pristine white sand. Top notes of bergamot and pink grapefruit ignite a luminous, citrus-forward opening that softens into a heart of rose and peony. The base settles into warm amber and driftwood, creating an elegant second skin that lingers like salt spray and golden hour light.

This is a fragrance for those who seek both refinement and carefree elegance — perfect for warm days, seaside escapes, and moments when luxury feels effortless. A limited-edition composition that brings the allure of Greek island living into your everyday ritual.

title: Maison Asrar Vanilla Aura Eau de Parfum for Unisex
body_html:
Maison Asrar – Vanilla Aura Eau de Parfum

Where warmth turns into radiance. Vanilla Aura glows with citrus brightness before melting into ribbons of caramel and molten chocolate, resting on a veil of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla — each note moving like light over silk. A fragrance of quiet strength and luminous grace, designed for lovers of gourmand, enveloping, and powerful scents.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Lily of the Valley
  • Heart: Caramel, Vanilla, Chocolate
  • Base: Amber, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Vanilla

The fragrance opens with a lively, luminous trio of bergamot, lemon, and lily of the valley — bringing an elegant freshness that paves the way for assertive indulgence. As it unfolds, the heart reveals a luscious fusion of caramel, chocolate, and creamy vanilla, warm and irresistibly smooth. The dry-down settles into a sensual base of amber, sandalwood, tonka bean, and lasting vanilla, creating a soft, skin-like warmth that lingers beautifully.

Housed in a refined bottle with a luminous amber gradation and sculptural gold cap, Vanilla Aura is elegant, inviting, and effortlessly wearable — a fragrance that explores every facet of vanilla, from fresh and citrusy to sensual and woody.

images.alt: Maison Asrar Vanilla Aura Eau de Parfum for Unisex

title: Maison Asrar Legacy Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Maison Asrar – Legacy Eau de Parfum

Greatness isn't claimed, it's earned. Legacy is the scent of quiet power — a composition built on bold contrasts, more than a fragrance, a statement of enduring presence. Presented in a midnight-blue bottle adorned with an oriental gold motif, it evokes the grandeur and heritage of Dubai-style luxury.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top: Pear, Ginger, Bergamot
  • Heart: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Woody Notes
  • Base: Musk, Amber, Vanilla

Spicy ginger and crisp pear open with an electric energy, softened by the fresh zest of bergamot. In the heart, the delicate yet unwavering presence of orange blossom and jasmine speaks to timeless refinement, layered over a rich woody undertone. The dry-down settles into a warm, sensual accord of musk, amber, and vanilla — delivering long-lasting hold and a refined, luminous trail.

A perfect balance between the fruity vivacity of ginger and the floral sensuality of jasmine, sublimated by a warm, enveloping base — Legacy embodies the olfactory signature of ambitious, refined souls.

Fresh, magnetic, and unforgettable, Overdose doesn't just leave an impression — it becomes one.

title: Mykonos Glitch Extrait de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Mykonos x SetiawanAde – Glitch Extrait de Parfum

Made for those who thrive in the fast lane, Glitch captures the electric pulse of modern life in a bottle. Some fragrances are made to blend in — this one was created to stand out. Crafted in extrait concentration, it's a bold, futuristic scent that moves from bright and energetic to warm and confidently grounded.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top: Sicilian Bergamot, Apple, Grapefruit, Charred Pineapple
  • Heart: Lavender, Artemisia, Lily of the Valley, Pink Pepper, Vanilla, Dried Jasmine
  • Base: Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk

Glitch opens with a crisp, invigorating rush of Sicilian bergamot, crisp apple, and zesty grapefruit, sharpened by an unexpected note of charred pineapple — fresh, electric, and impossible to ignore. At its core, a refined blend of lavender, artemisia, and lily of the valley meets pink pepper and dried jasmine, adding depth and a smooth aromatic contrast. The scent finishes strong with a clean, woody-musky base of patchouli and vanilla, leaving behind a confident, long-lasting trail.

Modern and versatile, Glitch is a citrus-woody composition with a futuristic edge — wearable in every season, for those who want a signature that feels stylish and unmistakably their own.

title: Mykonos Slow Living Extrait de Parfum for Unisex

Mykonos – Slow Living Extrait de Parfum

Slow Living captures the feeling of peaceful mornings, clean air, and carefree days spent doing absolutely nothing. Crafted in extrait concentration for richer depth and longer wear, it's a fresh, effortlessly calming fragrance built for those who value presence over dominance — the scent equivalent of a slow Sunday.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top: Lemon, Bergamot, Orange, Grapefruit, Fruity Notes
  • Heart: White Flowers, Lily, Jasmine, Raspberry, Tea Rose
  • Base: Musk, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla

The opening is a sparkling burst of lemon, bergamot, orange, and grapefruit, layered with juicy fruity nuances for an uplifting citrus lift. The heart softens into elegant white flowers, jasmine, lily, and tea rose, brushed with a hint of raspberry for a smooth, airy sweetness. As it settles, musk, sandalwood, and cedarwood weave together with amber and vanilla, leaving a soft, creamy woody trail that feels relaxing and quietly addictive.

Elegant yet easygoing, Slow Living is designed for everyday wear — bright and clean without ever feeling loud, with the added richness and longevity that comes from its high-concentration extrait form.

title: Armaf El Cielo

El Cielo is a citrus aromatic fragrance that captures the feeling of a cloudless summer sky — open, luminous, and completely without limits. Light-hearted yet sophisticated, it is the kind of scent that draws people closer without ever trying too hard.

The opening is pure, joyful freshness. Cooling melon, crisp green apple, sun-warmed bergamot, and zesty lemon arrive in a bright, fruity burst that instantly lifts the mood — clean, sweet, and utterly invigorating. It is the olfactive equivalent of a perfect day with nowhere to be and everywhere to go.

As the fragrance breathes into its heart, a refined floral and aromatic elegance takes over. Cool lavender, soft violet, and the resinous, slightly spicy depth of cypress weave together beautifully — adding sophistication and dimension to the breezy opening, grounding the lightness with quiet confidence.

The dry-down is warm, smooth, and irresistibly inviting. Creamy vanilla, golden amber, clean musk, and a whisper of cedar settle softly onto the skin, creating a gentle, sensual trail that lingers with effortless charm long after the day has passed.

Fresh enough for summer. Warm enough for all year. Irresistible for any occasion.

title: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Every great love story has a beginning. For Emporio Armani's Stronger with You collection, this is it. The Eau de Toilette that started it all — the fragrance that introduced the world to the now-iconic chestnut accord and proved that masculine warmth could be both sweet and deeply sophisticated. Fresh, spirited, and irresistibly charming, it remains one of the most beloved men's fragrances of its generation.

The opening is bright and lively — a playful burst of pink pepper and cardamom that announces its presence without overwhelming, leaving just enough mystery to draw people closer. There's a youthful electricity to these first moments, a feeling of possibility and movement that perfectly captures the spirit of a young man stepping confidently into the world.

The heart is where Stronger with You earns its name. The signature chestnut note blooms alongside violet leaves and sage, creating a warmth that feels genuinely unique — sweet but never cloying, soft but never weak. It's the kind of scent that makes people lean in and ask what you're wearing.

As it dries down, a clean blend of vanilla, cedarwood, and white musk settles close to the skin — comfortable, intimate, and effortlessly wearable from morning through evening. The longevity is solid for an EDT, with moderate projection that keeps you noticeable without demanding attention.

images.alt: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Eau de Toilette for Men

title: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Parfum for Men
body_html:
Some fragrances tell you who you are. Stronger with You Parfum tells you who you could become. The most intense and sensual chapter in Giorgio Armani's beloved Stronger with You story, this Parfum concentration strips away everything unnecessary and leaves only the essence — warm, addictive, and deeply human.

It opens with a quiet confidence. No loud citrus fanfare, no flashy opening act — just a smooth, spiced warmth that feels like it was already part of you. Cardamom and pink pepper ease in gently, adding just enough edge to keep it interesting without ever feeling aggressive. The heart is where the magic settles — a rich chestnut and violet accord, sweetly masculine and unexpectedly tender, giving the fragrance its signature emotional pull. This is the note that made the Stronger with You lineage iconic, and here it reaches its fullest expression.

The base is the reason you'll reach for this bottle again and again. Vanilla, vetiver, and a deep woody musk create a dry-down so skin-close and intimate that it feels less like wearing a perfume and more like revealing something true about yourself. Long-lasting and intensely sillaged, it projects without shouting.

This is a fragrance for the man who has grown into himself — assured, passionate, and present. Wear it when it matters. Wear it when you want to be remembered.

The opening is an immediate immersion — crisp water notes and zesty citrus crash together like a wave, cool and energising against the skin. The heart takes an unexpected turn, weaving in subtle florals and aromatic herbs that add sophistication to the freshness, keeping it from ever feeling predictable. Then the base arrives — deeper and more enveloping than the original, with sandalwood, amber woods, and white musks anchoring the scent in a warmth that makes it impossible to ignore as the day wears on.

Where Eau Fraiche was bright and breezy, Extreme is magnetic. It carries the same sun-drenched Mediterranean spirit but wraps it in a confidence that lingers long after you've left the room.

Perfect for the man who wants freshness with staying power — a signature scent that moves from morning to midnight without losing its edge.

Presented in the iconic Versace Medusa flacon with a cool blue finish, it's a collector's piece as much as a fragrance.

title: Creed Aventus Sample
body_html:
Creed Aventus — Official Brand Sample | 1.7ml

Experience the most iconic and celebrated fragrance in modern niche perfumery before you commit to the full bottle. This is an official sample produced and distributed by Maison Creed itself — a generous 1.7ml opportunity to spend real, meaningful time with a fragrance that has achieved near-mythological status in the world of fine perfumery, worn properly on your own skin across multiple occasions.

About the Fragrance:

Aventus — Some fragrances are popular. Aventus is a phenomenon. Since its launch in 2010 to commemorate Creed's 250th anniversary, Aventus has redefined what a men's fragrance can be — inspiring obsession, debate, and devotion in equal measure across every corner of the fragrance world.

Inspired by the turbulent, triumphant life of Napoleon Bonaparte — his strength, his ambition, his victories, and his resilience — Aventus opens with a dramatic, smoky burst of blackcurrant and pineapple that is unlike anything else in perfumery. Bold, confident, and immediately arresting. The heart reveals a noble accord of birch, jasmine, and rose that adds elegance and complexity, before the fragrance settles into its legendary dry down of oakmoss, ambergris, musk, and vanilla — rich, warm, and profoundly satisfying.

The result is a fragrance of extraordinary versatility, longevity, and universal appeal. Boardroom or black tie, summer or winter, first date or anniversary — Aventus rises to every occasion with effortless authority. There is a reason it has topped best fragrance lists year after year, and there is only one way to truly understand why — wear it.

title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Sample
body_html:
Classics never go out of style. And the Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum for men is one of those classics. It elegantly combines forest freshness and pure masculinity. It is ideal for a walk in the Irish countryside but would also make a great accessory for the red carpet. It will fit its wearer like a tailored suit and will engrave itself irreversibly into his memory.

  • a woody, fresh fragrance
  • for the classic gentleman
  • perfect for year-round wear as well as special occasions

Composition of the fragrance
The fragrance opens with fresh lemon, Indian verbena and a touch of mint. Shortly after the initial notes, the personality of the fragrance comes to light as you experience the subtle scent of violet leaves. The last phase consists of velvety Florentine iris accompanied by warm sandalwood and ambergris, which will embrace your senses like a snug tweed jacket.

Story of the fragrance
Creed Green Irish Tweed is the best-known and best-selling Eau de Parfum by the brand. Its composition evokes the lush Irish countryside; freshly cut grass, spring meadows, summer flowers and herbs swaying in the sea breeze.

This fragrance, as well as all other Creed fragrances, is made using a unique infusion technique. Each ingredient is weighed, mixed and macerated by hand, sticking to tradition. The Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum was created by Olivier Creed in 1985.

title: Creed Original Santal Sample
body_html:
Original Santal is an aromatic Oriental fragrance for men and women made by the unique luxury, dynastic and privately owned niche perfume brand Creed. As well as an exceptional tradition passed down from father to son since 1760 and a celebrated history (more than 250 years of creating exceptional fragrances for royal families and other exacting customers with refined tastes), the Creed brand can also boast the use of classic techniques when processing the rare materials selected for the production of its unrivalled perfumes. The Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum offers a rich aroma inspired by the sublime and spiritual wonder of India.

The modern Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum, which encapsulates the spiritual beauty of exotic India, is a joint project by Olivier Creed, a leading perfumer from the sixth generation of the Creed dynasty, and Erwin Creed, from the seventh generation. The aromatic composition masterfully combines the essence of the wood of Indian sandalwood trees with other pure elements known for their wonderfully refined fragrances, spiritual strength and soothing power.

Creed Original Santal opens in the head with notes of coriander, juniper berries, cinnamon and sandalwood. The heart contains rosemary, ginger, lavender and bitter orange, while the base consists of tones of tonka beans and vanilla. The overall aroma of the Original Santal Eau de Parfum stunningly combines aromatic, woody, fresh and warm spicy aspects with a light balsamic attribute and the bitter-sweet sensual touch of cinnamon. Red as a ruby, Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum helps its wearer to achieve inner peace.

Charged with a rich, soothing and spiritual character, the Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum is suitable for day and early evening wear all year round. It will appeal to men and women who like aromatic Oriental fragrances. It envelops its wearer in a rich, exotic aroma and helps him or her to get through even the most demanding day. Everybody who appreciates true quality based on many years of tradition should also be sure to try it.

The perfumes from the Creed brand are attractive not only thanks to their enchanting fragrances, but also their exceptional and elegantly beautiful packaging. The enchanting Original Santal flacon, in a ruby colour which transitions to pure transparency, provides a perfect visual representation of its aromatic contents. Try this Eau de Parfum from an exceptional dynastic brand with a celebrated history and you will fall in love with this wonderful richly Oriental fragrance, which will bring you spiritual power from distant India.

Creed Original Santal - a rich Oriental fragrance full of calm strength and spiritual character.

title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Sample
body_html:
Snow-covered mountain tops, frozen mountain springs, and unbridled nature. Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum for men is perfect for anyone who loves the mountains, skiing, and nature. Its aromatic composition will give you energy every single day, whether you have an important meeting, a long day at work, or you’re going for a hike.

  • aromatic composition
  • for a modern man who gets his energy from nature
  • ideal especially for spring and summer

Composition of the fragrance
The opening will delight you with citrussy, slightly bitter notes of bergamot and juicy tangerine. The heart of the fragrance is dominated by blackcurrant and the delicate aroma of top-quality green tea. Finally, the sensuous drydown brings out rare musk and intoxicating galbanum. Seductive notes of warm sandalwood are livened up by a drop of inimitable petitgrain – an essential oil obtained from the leaves and green, unripe fruits of the lemon tree.

Story of the fragrance
Creed Silver Mountain Water was introduced in 1995. In creating its composition, perfumer Olivier Creed was inspired by the snowy mountain tops he as an avid skier loved so much. The bottle of Silver Mountain Water evokes the image of the Swiss Alps with mountains covered in snow and mountain springs whose water has frozen into extraordinary shapes.

title: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Parfums de Marly Haltane is a fragrance designed for the modern gentleman, drawing inspiration from the refined elegance of the 18th-century gentilhommes of the Chateau de Marly. It pays homage to the tradition of French perfume making with a composition that showcases rare and noble ingredients, creating a scent that is both radiant and shadowy.

The fragrance opens with a dazzling freshness and herbal top notes that immediately captivate the senses. This initial burst of freshness gives way to a warm and smooth leather accord, accompanied by a symphony of precious woods. The combination of these elements creates a sense of sophistication and depth, evoking the ambiance of the Chateau de Marly.

As the fragrance develops, a soft and sweet praline accord emerges, infused with the alluring aroma of saffron. This unique twist on oud wood adds a contemporary touch to the composition, bringing together the traditional and the modern in perfect harmony.

At the heart of Haltane lies agarwood, also known as oud, which adds a luminous refinement to the fragrance. Agarwood is renowned for its rich and complex scent, and in Haltane, it leaves an enduring impression of comfort and luxury on the skin. The combination of contrasting elements creates a veil of contrasts, where brightness and darkness coexist in perfect balance.

Wearing Haltane is a sensory experience, a privilege reserved for those who appreciate the art of perfumery. It is a fragrance that exudes sophistication, elegance, and timeless charm. Haltane embodies the spirit of the 18th-century gentilhommes, encapsulating their refined tastes and capturing the essence of their distinguished lifestyle.

For the modern gentleman seeking a fragrance that is both classic and contemporary, Haltane offers a unique olfactory journey that transcends time and leaves a lasting impression. It is a privilege to indulge in the sensation of this exquisite composition, crafted with meticulous attention to detail and a passion for the art of perfumery.

title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu for Men
body_html:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Eau de Parfum for Men

Le Male Elixir Absolu is Jean Paul Gaultier's most concentrated and intense interpretation of the iconic Le Male lineage. Where the original Le Male is a masterpiece of fresh lavender and vanilla, Elixir Absolu takes that DNA and pushes it into darker, richer territory — more amber, more resin, more depth. This is not a casual daytime fragrance. It is a deliberate, after-dark statement built for the man who wants to leave an impression that outlasts the evening.

The opening is immediate and commanding. Cardamom and a spiced accord cut through first, warm and slightly smoky, before the heart settles into the lavender that has always defined this family. But this is not a fresh, airy lavender — it is a deeper, more resinous version, grounded by tonka bean and vanilla in a way that feels genuinely opulent rather than simply sweet.

The base is where Elixir Absolu separates itself entirely from the rest of the Le Male collection. Amber, sandalwood, and a rich musky accord settle into the skin over several hours, creating a drydown that is warm, sensual, and long-lasting. Performance is exceptional — easily 8 to 10 hours on skin with significant projection in the opening hours. On fabric, it lasts considerably longer.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Spiced Accord
Heart: Lavender, Tonka Bean
Base: Amber, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Oriental, Fougère, Amber
  • Character: Dark, Warm, Sensual, Intense
  • Season: Autumn, Winter — best in cool to cold weather; genuinely stunning on cold nights
  • Occasion: Evening, Date Night, Formal, Special Occasions — not an office or daytime fragrance

How It Fits Into the Le Male Family

If you've worn Le Male or Le Male Le Parfum and want something more powerful and more uncompromising, Elixir Absolu is the natural next step. It shares the lavender and vanilla DNA of the family but strips away anything light or approachable. The result is a fragrance that rewards patience — the first hour is bold and occasionally polarising, but the drydown is genuinely magnificent.

Among the Le Male variants, the hierarchy runs roughly from freshest to darkest: Le Male, Le Male Terrible, Le Male Le Parfum, and finally Elixir Absolu at the deepest and most intense end. If you have worn any of the others and found them too light for your tastes, this is the version you have been looking for.

Who Should Buy This

Le Male Elixir Absolu is best suited to experienced fragrance wearers who know they prefer warm, oriental masculines and want a designer-level fragrance that performs like a niche. If you are new to fragrances or prefer fresh, light, or aquatic scents, this will almost certainly feel too heavy — apply it on someone who prefers that profile and watch the reaction.

For the man who already owns and loves fragrances like Dior Sauvage Elixir, Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense, or any of the Afnan Supremacy range, Elixir Absolu will feel immediately comfortable but distinctly more refined and European in character. At its price point, it punches significantly above its weight.

A Note on Application

Given the concentration and projection of this fragrance, less is more. Two to three sprays on pulse points is sufficient for an evening occasion. Applying to fabric — particularly a scarf or jacket lapel — will extend longevity dramatically and soften the opening, which is the most intense part of the wear experience.

title: French Avenue Amber Empire Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
French Avenue Amber Empire Eau de Parfum for Men 100ml

Amber Empire announces its intentions immediately and without apology. This is a rich, opulent oriental fragrance built around the warmth of amber, the sweetness of vanilla, and the deep complexity of labdanum and tonka — a composition that is unapologetically luxurious from the first spray to the final drydown. At a price point that significantly undercuts Western alternatives with similar DNA, it represents one of the more compelling value propositions in the French Avenue lineup.

The opening is immediate and enveloping. Vanilla pod arrives first — not the thin, synthetic vanilla of lesser fragrances, but a rich, creamy, almost edible quality that sets the tone for everything that follows. Oriental notes add a warm, spiced complexity that prevents the opening from ever feeling one-dimensional, while a touch of liquor gives it an intriguing boozy edge that adds sophistication and character. Cashmere wood rounds the opening with a soft, smooth woodiness that anchors the sweetness and stops it from becoming overwhelming. This is an opening that draws people in from the very first moment.

The heart is where Amber Empire builds its reputation. Amber settles at the core — warm, golden, and luminous — creating that characteristic glow that makes amber-centric fragrances so compulsively wearable. Cedarwood adds a dry, clean woodiness that provides structure and prevents the composition from collapsing under the weight of its own richness. Sugar cane introduces a subtle sweetness that ties the heart to the vanilla of the opening, maintaining continuity through the fragrance's development and ensuring Amber Empire always feels like a coherent whole rather than a collection of disconnected phases.

The base is exceptional. Tonka bean adds its characteristic warm, almond-like sweetness, labdanum brings a dark, resinous depth that gives the fragrance genuine gravitas, and sandalwood contributes a creamy, smooth woodiness that carries everything on a cushion of warmth. Musk ties the entire composition together with an intimate, skin-close quality that makes Amber Empire feel personal rather than theatrical.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Vanilla Pod, Oriental Notes, Liquor, Cashmere Wood
Heart: Amber, Cedarwood, Sugar Cane
Base: Tonka Bean, Labdanum, Sandalwood, Musk

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Oriental, Woody, Amber
  • Character: Warm, Rich, Opulent, Seductive
  • Season: Autumn, Winter — built for cooler weather and evenings; the warmth of the amber and vanilla base performs best when the temperature drops
  • Occasion: Evening, Date Night, Formal Events, Special Occasions — a fragrance that demands an occasion worthy of it
  • Projection: Strong in the opening, settling into a warm, skin-close sillage that lingers intimately

Who Should Buy This

Amber Empire is not a fragrance for those who prefer to go unnoticed. It is warm, sweet, and unmistakably present — the kind of fragrance that people remember long after you have left the room. It suits confident wearers who appreciate the opulence of oriental perfumery and want a signature evening scent that makes a genuine impression.

That said, the cedarwood and sandalwood in the heart and base provide enough structure to prevent Amber Empire from ever becoming cloying or one-dimensional. The woodiness keeps the sweetness honest, and the labdanum base adds a darkness that gives the fragrance genuine depth and maturity. This is not a simple gourmand — it is a fully realised oriental composition that happens to be immediately accessible and consistently wearable. For anyone who loves the warmth and richness of amber-based orientals and wants something that delivers that experience at a fraction of the usual price, Amber Empire is a straightforward recommendation.

About French Avenue

French Avenue is a Fragrance World brand crafted in Dubai, built on the philosophy of combining Middle Eastern perfumery traditions with European fragrance sensibilities. Amber Empire represents that philosophy operating at its most quintessentially Middle Eastern — a fragrance rooted in the region's deep love of amber, resins, and warm oriental ingredients, delivered with the kind of compositional refinement that makes it genuinely wearable in any context rather than simply impressive in a bottle.

title: French Avenue Obsidion Extrait de Parfum for Men
body_html:
French Avenue Obsidion Extrait de Parfum for Men 100ml

Obsidion is a fragrance that understands contrast. It opens bright and citrus-forward, then pulls you steadily into something darker, richer, and considerably more complex. The journey from the first spray to the final drydown covers a remarkable amount of ground — and at Extrait de Parfum concentration, every stage of that journey is amplified and extended well beyond what a standard EDP could deliver.

The opening is clean, sharp, and immediately likeable. Grapefruit arrives first with a bitter, zesty brightness that feels genuinely fresh rather than sweet, followed closely by bergamot which adds a classic citrus elegance to the early minutes. The aldehydes are the most interesting element here — they add a slightly powdery, almost metallic luminosity that elevates the opening beyond a simple citrus fragrance and gives Obsidion its distinctive character from the very first spray. This is not a simple opening. It is one that announces intention.

The heart is where Obsidion earns its name. Labdanum brings a dark, resinous warmth that begins to anchor the brightness of the opening, while myrrh adds a smoky, slightly balsamic depth that runs underneath everything like a current. Jasmine weaves through both of these, providing a floral softness that prevents the heart from ever feeling heavy or oppressive. The balance here is genuinely impressive — the resinous and the floral elements hold each other in check, creating a mid-section that is rich and layered without ever becoming difficult to wear.

The base is where Obsidion settles into its final, memorable form. Tonka bean brings a warm almond-like sweetness, vanilla adds depth and creaminess, and amber ties everything together into a smooth, golden, skin-close finish that lingers beautifully. The drydown is long-lasting and intimate — one of those bases that stays close to the skin but rewards anyone who comes near enough to notice.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Aldehydes
Heart: Labdanum, Myrrh, Jasmine
Base: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Amber

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Oriental, Floral, Aldehyic
  • Character: Dark, Warm, Sophisticated, Distinctive
  • Season: Autumn, Winter — a natural cold-weather fragrance; the resinous heart and warm base perform exceptionally in cooler temperatures
  • Occasion: Evening, Date Night, Formal Events, Special Occasions — a statement fragrance that suits occasions worthy of it
  • Projection: Moderate to strong — confident in the opening, settling into a rich, skin-close drydown

Who Should Buy This

Obsidion is a fragrance for the experienced wearer who understands what resins and aldehydes can do in the right hands. It is not a fragrance that announces itself loudly or tries to please everyone — it has a clear character, a specific mood, and a confident sense of direction. Wear it when the occasion matches its ambition.

That said, the vanilla and tonka base keep Obsidion accessible in a way that purely resinous fragrances often are not. The sweetness of the drydown gives it a warmth that draws people in rather than keeping them at distance. It works on men who want something with genuine depth and complexity — something that evolves on the skin over the course of a day and rewards patience. For anyone who has found most fragrances in this price range to be forgettable, Obsidion is a direct answer to that frustration.

About French Avenue

French Avenue is a Fragrance World brand crafted in Dubai, built around the philosophy of combining Middle Eastern perfumery traditions with European fragrance sensibilities. The Obsidion Extrait represents that philosophy operating at its most ambitious — a fragrance that draws on classical French perfumery elements like aldehydes and labdanum while grounding them in the warm, resinous richness that Middle Eastern perfumery does better than anyone else in the world.

body_html:

Burberry Goddess Intense is a bold, gourmand‑woody Eau de Parfum that radiates confidence, strength, and grace—a modern olfactory ode to self‑discovery. Fragrance Composition & Notes

Character & Story
This scent is a sensory narrative of empowerment. The lavender adds clarity and bloom, the vanilla layers bring indulgence, the smoky vanilla wood adds intrigue, and patchouli delivers elegance. Together, they create a fragrance that is alluringly strong yet intimate—perfect for embracing your inner goddess at any moment.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Intense luxury: The smoky twist to the iconic vanilla elevates the gourmand profile into something richer and more commanding.

  • Versatile elegance: Warm and spicy yet refined enough for both day and evening wear.

  • Eco-conscious design: The refillable bottle underscores Burberry’s commitment to sustainability and heritage.

Fragrance Style: Gourmand, Woody, Ambery, Warm & Spicy—with an aromatic twist.

title: Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum for Men 100ml

Rare Reef is a fragrance that earns its name — there is something genuinely aquatic and alive about it from the very first spray. Fresh, bright, and immediately distinctive, it is the kind of fragrance that announces itself confidently without ever crossing into aggression. At Extrait de Parfum concentration, it carries a depth and richness that standard EDPs rarely match at this price point.

The opening is exactly what the name promises. Fresh citrus cuts through first, clean and sharp, quickly joined by an aquatic quality that evokes open water rather than synthetic marine accords. It does not smell like a clichéd beach fragrance — it smells like the air just above the water, bright and alive. The opening projects well and draws attention from the first spray without needing to overpower.

The heart is where Rare Reef builds its complexity. Aquatic florals and crisp spices emerge to give the composition genuine depth, preventing it from ever feeling one-dimensional. This is a well-constructed middle phase that rewards patience — the freshness of the opening evolves into something richer and more interesting as the fragrance develops on the skin.

The base is the most impressive part of Rare Reef. Smooth woods, rich amber, and sensual musk settle into a warm, grounding drydown that sits in elegant contrast to the freshness of the opening. The transition from bright aquatic to warm woody base is handled exceptionally well — there is no jarring shift, just a gradual deepening that keeps the fragrance interesting throughout its life on skin.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citrus, Aquatic Notes
Heart: Aquatic Florals, Crisp Spices
Base: Smooth Woods, Amber, Musk

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Aquatic, Woody, Amber
  • Character: Fresh, Refined, Sophisticated, Masculine
  • Season: Spring, Summer — performs exceptionally well in warm weather; the aquatic freshness suits Indian summers particularly
  • Occasion: Office, Daily Wear, Date Night, Casual — genuinely versatile across occasions
  • Projection: Strong in the opening, settling into a refined skin scent with moderate sillage

Who Should Buy This

Rare Reef is built for the man who wants something fresh and distinctive without sacrificing longevity or depth. If you have struggled to find an aquatic fragrance that actually lasts — most EDPs in this family fade within a few hours — the Extrait concentration makes Rare Reef a genuinely different proposition. You get the freshness of an aquatic without the performance penalty that usually comes with it.

It is versatile enough for the office and interesting enough for an evening out. It works in warm weather without feeling summery in a limiting way, and the warm base means it carries itself well into cooler evenings too. For anyone building a fragrance collection and looking for a strong aquatic representative, Rare Reef at Extrait concentration is among the most compelling options at this price point.

About Afnan

Afnan Perfumes is one of the most respected names in Middle Eastern fragrance, operating out of Ajman, UAE. The brand is known for building fragrances that deliver genuine quality and performance at prices that undercut most Western niche alternatives significantly. The Rare Reef Extrait sits at the intersection of Afnan's technical expertise and their understanding of what makes a fragrance truly wearable — not just impressive on first spray, but genuinely worth returning to day after day.

title: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum for Men 100ml

Marwa is a fragrance built around a specific kind of confidence — the kind that does not announce itself loudly but makes itself known. Refined, structured, and genuinely versatile, it sits comfortably between the freshness of a daytime fragrance and the warmth of an evening one, making it one of the more useful additions to any collection.

The opening is clean and immediately appealing. Fresh citrus arrives first — bright and clear — before aromatic herbs follow with a crispness that feels considered rather than accidental. There is clarity here from the very first spray, a sense that this fragrance knows exactly what it wants to be. It projects well without being aggressive, and the opening alone is enough to draw a second look.

The heart is where Marwa builds its character. Warm spices emerge gradually, adding depth to what began as a fresh fragrance, while subtle florals weave through the composition and soften the transition. This middle phase is genuinely interesting — it manages to feel simultaneously sophisticated and approachable, which is a balance that most fragrances in this category struggle to achieve.

The base is smooth and commanding without ever becoming heavy. Creamy sandalwood anchors everything, sensual musk adds warmth, and rich woods provide the structure that keeps the fragrance feeling composed rather than diffuse. skin with excellent fabric retention beyond that. The sillage is moderate, leaving a trail that is noticed by those close to you without filling a room.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citrus, Aromatic Herbs
Heart: Warm Spices, Subtle Florals
Base: Sandalwood, Musk, Rich Woods

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Fresh Aromatic, Oriental
  • Character: Refined, Versatile, Confident, Masculine
  • Season: Spring, Autumn — performs well year-round but particularly suits cooler mornings and evenings
  • Occasion: Office, Daily Wear, Date Night, Formal Events
  • Projection: Moderate — a confident trail without being overpowering

Who Should Buy This

Marwa is the kind of fragrance that suits a wide range of men precisely because it does not try to do too much. It is fresh enough for the office, warm enough for an evening out, and refined enough to wear to a formal event without a second thought. If you are building a collection and need a fragrance that genuinely works across multiple occasions without compromise, Marwa earns its place.

It is particularly well suited to the man who wants to smell distinctive without drawing attention to the fact that he is wearing fragrance. The projection is confident but measured, the character is sophisticated without being demanding, and the longevity means you will not need to reapply through the day. For anyone exploring the Arabiyat Prestige range for the first time, Marwa is one of the more accessible and immediately rewarding starting points.

About Arabiyat Prestige

Arabiyat Prestige is a Dubai-based fragrance house that brings together Middle Eastern perfumery traditions and contemporary sensibilities. The range is built on the idea that luxury fragrance should be accessible without feeling compromised — and Marwa makes that case convincingly. It is the kind of fragrance that earns its place in a collection not through novelty but through consistent, dependable quality.

title: Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum for Men 100ml

Afnan Supremacy Collector's Edition is a bold, opulent fragrance built for the man who wants to be noticed. It sits in the heavy oriental masculine category — the kind of fragrance that announces itself, fills a room, and lingers well after you've left. If you've worn Creed Aventus or Lattafa Asad and want something with a darker, smokier edge, this is worth serious attention.

The opening is immediate and commanding. Bergamot and black pepper cut through first, sharp and confident, before a wave of saffron adds the rich, slightly smoky warmth that defines the Supremacy lineage. This is not a light or casual opening — it demands presence from the first spray.

The heart develops into a sophisticated blend of oud, smoky incense, and dark florals. The oud here is well-handled — resinous and deep without crossing into medicinal territory. Combined with the incense, it creates the kind of smoky, almost leathery mid-section that Middle Eastern perfumery does better than anyone else in the world.

The base is where Supremacy Collector's Edition truly earns its name. Amber, patchouli, and musk settle into a rich, creamy, long-lasting drydown that stays close to skin but projects beautifully. Performance is genuinely exceptional — expect 10+ hours on skin and fabric retention that lasts even longer.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Black Pepper, Saffron
Heart: Oud, Incense, Dark Florals
Base: Amber, Patchouli, Musk

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Oriental, Woody, Smoky
  • Character: Bold, Dark, Opulent, Masculine
  • Season: Autumn, Winter — best in cooler weather; a standout evening fragrance
  • Occasion: Evening, Formal, Date Night, Special Occasions
  • Projection: Strong — this is a room-filler, not a skin scent
  • Longevity: Exceptional — 10+ hours on skin, longer on fabric

Who Should Buy This

Supremacy Collector's Edition is not for the faint-hearted or for fragrance beginners looking for something easy and crowd-pleasing. This is a statement fragrance — heavy, smoky, and unapologetically bold. It suits confident, experienced fragrance wearers who appreciate the depth of oud-based Middle Eastern perfumery and want a signature scent that is unmistakably theirs.

If you tend to prefer lighter, fresher fragrances, this will likely feel overwhelming. But if you're drawn to the Supremacy line, love fragrances like Lattafa Oud for Glory or Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud, or simply want a powerful winter evening fragrance that performs for a full day — this belongs in your collection.

The Supremacy Collection

The Supremacy name from Afnan is synonymous with power and longevity. The Collector's Edition sits at the top of that lineage — a more refined, more complex take on what makes the Supremacy range so beloved. It shares the same DNA of heavy projection and exceptional performance but adds layers of oud and incense that make it feel genuinely special rather than simply loud.

title: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum for Unisex
body_html:
French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum for Unisex 100ml

Liquid Brun is a fragrance that earns its place in a collection through sheer wearability. Rich without being heavy, warm without being suffocating — it occupies that rare middle ground between a statement fragrance and an everyday companion. This is the kind of scent you reach for when you want to smell genuinely distinguished without trying too hard.

The opening is confident and assured. Citrus lifts the first impression — bright and clean — before aromatic spices follow immediately behind, adding an interesting edge that prevents the opening from ever feeling simple. From the very first spray, Liquid Brun signals that it has more going on beneath the surface than most fragrances at this price point.

The heart is where the fragrance finds its identity. Warm amber settles in at the core, adding a golden, almost luminous richness that stops well short of sweetness. Smooth woods wrap around it, providing structure and quiet depth that keep the composition grounded. This is a well-balanced mid-section that develops slowly and rewards patience — it keeps evolving through the first hour and consistently surprises.

The base is where Liquid Brun truly justifies its name. Musk, vanilla, and rich leather dry down into something that feels intimate and personal — skin-close enough to feel like your own warmth, but distinctive enough that people around you will notice and remember it. Performance is genuinely strong for the price — expect 6 to 8 hours on skin and excellent fabric retention well beyond that.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citrus, Aromatic Spices
Heart: Warm Amber, Smooth Woods
Base: Musk, Vanilla, Rich Leather

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Oriental Woody
  • Character: Warm, Rich, Sophisticated, Unisex
  • Season: Autumn, Winter — performs best in cooler weather; an excellent evening fragrance year-round
  • Occasion: Evening, Date Night, Formal Events, Special Occasions
  • Projection: Moderate to strong — projects confidently in the opening before settling into a rich skin scent
  • Longevity: Strong — 6 to 8 hours on skin, longer on fabric

Who Should Buy This

Liquid Brun is built for the person who wants a fragrance that commands attention without demanding it. It is not an aggressive fragrance, but it is not a shy one either. It sits confidently in a room, makes an impression, and stays true to its character from first spray to final drydown.

If you gravitate toward fragrances with genuine warmth and depth — scents that feel luxurious without being theatrical — Liquid Brun is a natural fit. It works equally well on men and women, making it one of the more genuinely unisex options in the French Avenue lineup. Whether you are new to Middle Eastern perfumery or adding to a considered collection, this punches well above its price point.

About French Avenue

French Avenue is a Fragrance World brand crafted in Dubai, built on the philosophy of combining Middle Eastern perfumery traditions with contemporary European sensibilities. The result is a range of fragrances that feel both familiar and distinctive — accessible enough for everyday wear, refined enough to hold their own alongside significantly more expensive alternatives. Liquid Brun sits at the heart of that approach, and represents the range at its most confident.

title: Miu Miu L'Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum for Women
body_html:
First you will be overwhelmed by the fragrance of the tender and blooming lily of the valley. Soon, a romantic floral heart opens up before you, made up of white flowers, jasmine, delicate rose and lush green tones. The composition of the fragrance is built on a base of velvety white musk and Akigalawood®, which has warm and slightly peppery tones that lend depth and sensuality to the fragrance.

Miu Miu L’Eau Bleue is a lighter version of the original Miu Miu fragrance. The bottle gives that fact away at first glance. title: Miu Miu Signature Eau de Parfum for Women
body_html:
The dominant element of this fragrance, which it also opens with, is the sensual and elegant essence of lily of the valley. The heart is supported by heady jasmine, roses and fresh green notes. This light and ingenuous overture contrasts with the darker base of Akigalawood® – an ingredient created from patchouli extract that has a pleasantly woody and slightly peppery aroma.

The Italian designer Miuccia Prada always wanted to project her playfulness and creativity into the world of fashion and beauty. In 1998, she founded the younger sister brand to Prada, Miu Miu, which combines the unexpected contrasts of the modern world. This idea is also reflected in the first fragrance by the brand, which was launched in 2015.

title: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau de Parfum for Men 100ml

Rasasi Hawas Ice is a fresh aquatic fragrance that takes everything the original Hawas does well and pushes it into cooler, crisper territory. Where the original leans warm and fruity, Hawas Ice opens with an icy burst of Sicilian Bergamot, Italian Lemon, and cooling Mint — an opening that works brilliantly in Indian heat, refreshing without being sharp, masculine without being heavy.

As the fragrance develops, the heart reveals its character. Orange Blossom adds a touch of floral softness, Cardamom brings warmth, and Plum introduces a subtle sweetness that keeps things from feeling one-dimensional. Blackcurrant weaves through with a tart fruitiness that adds depth and complexity.

The base is where Hawas Ice shows its quality. Patchouli, Amber, Tonka Bean, and Sandalwood create a warm, creamy foundation that anchors the fragrance and keeps it present well into the day. Customers consistently highlight the performance of Hawas Ice as one of its strongest qualities, with fabric retention often lasting considerably longer than on skin.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sicilian Bergamot, Italian Lemon, Mint Heart: Orange Blossom, Cardamom, Plum, Blackcurrant Base: Patchouli, Amber, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Aquatic, Fruity
  • Character: Fresh, Masculine, Sophisticated
  • Season: Spring, Summer — well suited to warm and humid Indian weather
  • Occasion: Office, Casual, Date Night, Daily Wear
  • Projection: Noticeable and present in the opening, settling into a closer skin scent as it develops
  • Versatility: A crowd-pleasing choice that works across a wide range of occasions and ages

The Aquatic Masculine Family

Hawas Ice belongs to the fresh aquatic masculine category — one of the most universally appreciated fragrance families in modern perfumery. Fragrances in this family are characterised by their clean, invigorating openings, broad appeal across ages and occasions, and ability to perform in warm weather without feeling heavy or cloying.


Within this category Hawas Ice stands out for the quality of its base notes — the patchouli, amber and tonka combination gives it a warmth and depth that many fragrances in this space lack, making the drydown as rewarding as the opening. It is one of the reasons Hawas Ice consistently earns a place in our roundups of the best long-lasting perfumes for men in India — fresh fragrances rarely perform this well, and Ice is one of the few in its category that genuinely does.

How it Differs From the Original Hawas

Hawas Ice and the original Rasasi Hawas share a DNA but occupy meaningfully different territory. Hawas is warmer, richer, and more versatile across seasons. Hawas Ice is cooler, fresher, and better suited to daytime and warm weather use. Many customers who discover one end up owning both — they complement each other rather than compete.

If you are buying your first Rasasi fragrance and live in a warm climate or are buying for summer, Hawas Ice is the natural starting point. If you want something that works year-round with slightly more depth and warmth, the original Hawas is the better choice.

Read the full breakdown: Rasasi Hawas vs Hawas Ice — which one should you buy?

Who Should Buy This

Hawas Ice is ideal for anyone who wants a crowd-pleasing, compliment-getting fragrance that performs in Indian heat without feeling heavy or cloying. Approachable enough for fragrance beginners and interesting enough for experienced collectors — students, professionals, and anyone who wants to smell genuinely great without spending a fortune will find this a versatile and reliable choice.

title: Costume National 21 Eau de Parfum for Women
body_html: "21" is a masterpiece of equilibrium, a fragrant opus that strikes a harmonious balance between the ethereal and the earthy, between the stark and the sensual. In this olfactory symphony, 21 carefully curated ingredients of the utmost refinement converge to create a multi-faceted fragrance that resonates with deep intrigue.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">Like the softest cashmere caressing the skin, "21" wraps the senses in an embrace that is both comforting and compelling. Its allure is enigmatic, its aromatic secrets beckoning the curious.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">At its core, the audacious saffron engages in a dance of contrasts with the pristine essence of milk, while the delicate orange blossom adds an understated grace. In the heart of this composition, the opulence of royal jelly takes center stage, alternately mingling with the sultry whispers of musk, the resinous depth of olibanum, and the piquant bite of black pepper. <br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">But the true crescendo is unveiled in the long-lasting dry-down, where "21" reveals its most profound and lasting essence. Here, the exquisite caress of cashmeran is paired with the beguiling allure of oud wood, the sacred echoes of labdanum, and the sweet embrace of vanilla. The result is an opulent and endlessly harmonious symphony that lingers in the memory, a testament to the artistry of fragrance creation. "21" is an olfactory masterpiece that epitomizes the marriage of the essential and the opulent, a fragrant journey that encapsulates both purity and sensuality, and a testament to the artistry of scent.

Vetiver, with its earthy richness, veils this olfactory creation with a shroud of enigmatic charm.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">In this fragrance, Costume National Scents has crafted more than a scent; it is an elixir of intrigue and seduction. title: Costume National Secret Woods Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html: In the heart of a pristine landscape, where untouched forests, verdant woods, and lush vegetation stretch as far as the eye can see, one finds solace in the symphony of silence and the awe-inspiring majesty of nature's unspoiled beauty.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">As this olfactory journey unfolds, a luminous flicker of citrus brilliance emanates, much like the first rays of dawn breaking over the horizon. Deep notes of styrax resinoid intermingle with the creamy allure of sandalwood, the woody accents, and the earthy, rain-kissed nuances of patchouli. This olfactory journey culminates in the sensual embrace of leather, a scent that evokes the timeless allure of exploration and adventure.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">Beneath it all, the earthy strength of vetiver emerges, like the anchor of ancient roots firmly embedded in the soil. It is a reminder of an ancestral sense of freedom that beckons us to explore, to seek, and to discover. In this fragrant landscape, the essence of nature converges with the spirit of man, creating a symphony of scents that captures the essence of unspoiled wilderness and the profound connection between humanity and the natural world.

It's a magnetic alchemy that weaves a spell of seduction, mystery, and above all, timeless elegance.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">Homme is more than a fragrance; it's an embodiment of the art of seduction and the enduring allure of mystery. It encapsulates the essence of a man who embodies timeless elegance in every facet of his life, from the clothes he wears to the scent he chooses to adorn himself with. title: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html: Introducing KENZO HOMME Eau de Toilette, a timeless and invigorating fragrance for men. Crafted by the perfumer Christian Matthieu, this woody marine scent captures the essence of a refreshing walk by the sea, surrounded by the soothing aroma of pine and sandalwood.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">The fragrance opens with a burst of freshness, reminiscent of sea sprays, which immediately invigorates the senses. This sparkling freshness sets the tone for the entire composition, creating a sense of rejuvenation and energy.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">As the scent develops, the green and woody notes of pine and sandalwood come to the forefront. The earthy and resinous aroma of pine conjures images of tree-lined paths near the sea, adding a touch of natural elegance to the fragrance. Sandalwood, known for its rich and creamy scent, brings warmth and depth to the composition, complementing the marine notes beautifully.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">The combination of marine freshness, green pine, and woody sandalwood creates a harmonious and uplifting experience, reminiscent of a revitalizing walk along the coast. KENZO HOMME Eau de Toilette is like a breath of salty air that caresses and refreshes the skin, leaving a lingering impression of natural elegance and invigoration.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">With its timeless appeal and evocative character, KENZO HOMME Eau de Toilette is the perfect fragrance for the modern man who seeks a scent that is both refreshing and sophisticated. It embodies the spirit of the sea and nature, offering a unique olfactory journey that captivates the senses and leaves a lasting impression.

In a market where fresh masculines often blur into each other, Hawas carved out its own identity — fruity without being sweet, aquatic without being generic, and warm enough in the base to feel substantial rather than throwaway.

The opening is immediately likeable. Bergamot and Lemon provide a bright citrus lift, Apple adds a juicy fruitiness that feels modern rather than candy-like, and Cinnamon introduces a quiet spice that gives the opening an interesting edge. It does not smell like a simple summer fragrance — there is genuine complexity here from the very first spray.

The heart is where Hawas builds its reputation. Cardamom deepens the spice character, Orange Blossom adds a subtle floral softness, and Plum brings a rich fruitiness that sits at the core of what makes this fragrance so distinctive. This combination creates something genuinely unique — simultaneously fresh and warm, masculine and approachable.

The base completes the picture with Grey Amber, Driftwood, Patchouli, and Musk. These are well-balanced base notes that serve to ground the fruity heart, giving the fragrance staying power and a warm skin-close character as it dries down. Customers regularly highlight the drydown of Hawas as the part that keeps them coming back — it is often cited as even better than the opening.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Apple, Cinnamon
Heart: Cardamom, Orange Blossom, Plum
Base: Grey Amber, Driftwood, Patchouli, Musk

Fragrance Profile

  • Family: Aquatic, Fruity, Oriental
  • Character: Fresh, Warm, Masculine, Distinctive
  • Season: Spring, Summer, Early Autumn — performs particularly well in warm Indian weather
  • Occasion: Office, Casual, Date Night, Daily Wear, Evening
  • Projection: Strong in the opening, settling into a warm skin scent as it develops
  • Versatility: Year-round wearability with a sweet spot in the warmer months

The Fruity Aquatic Oriental Family

Hawas sits at an interesting intersection of fragrance families — it has the freshness of an aquatic, the fruitiness of a modern masculine, and the warmth of an oriental base. This combination is what gives it such broad appeal and year-round wearability. It does not fully belong to any single category, which is precisely what makes it distinctive.

Fragrances with this kind of DNA tend to be the ones that earn a permanent place in a collection rather than being worn seasonally and forgotten. The balance of fresh and warm means there is rarely a wrong moment to reach for it.

How it Differs From Hawas Ice

The original Hawas is warmer, richer, and more versatile across seasons than its Ice counterpart. Hawas Ice leans cooler and more explicitly fresh, making it the better choice for peak summer heat. Hawas itself is the more rounded, all-season option that works across a broader range of occasions and weather conditions. Many customers who discover Hawas end up owning both — they serve genuinely different purposes in a collection.

Read the full breakdown: Rasasi Hawas vs Hawas Ice — which one should you buy?

How it Compares to Armaf Club de Nuit

Hawas and Armaf Club de Nuit Intense / Pure Parfum are the two fragrances most often cross-shopped at this price point in India. They sit in different DNA families — Hawas is fruity-aquatic-oriental, Club de Nuit Pure Parfum is the smoky pineapple-chypre Aventus archetype — but they compete for the same buyer: someone who wants serious projection and compliments without spending designer money. We asked our customers which one smells better, and the result was clearer than we expected. See for yourself.

Who Should Buy This

Rasasi Hawas is genuinely one of the easiest fragrance recommendations to make. If you are new to fragrances and want something that smells universally great, gets compliments, and does not require any expertise to appreciate — this is it. If you are an experienced collector looking for a reliable daily driver that punches well above its price — this is also it.

It works on students, professionals, and everyone in between. It works in the office, on a date, and running errands on a Sunday. For anyone buying their first Middle Eastern fragrance, Rasasi Hawas is among the most recommended starting points — and for good reason.

title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Express your singular nature through a fragrance full of courage and dynamic passion. Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette for men has been the essential accessory for many a gentleman since 1965. Succumb to the charm of this perfectly classic aftershave imbued with French elegance.

  • oriental fragrance with citrus elements
  • aroma with a sensual base and elegant drydown
  • gives you the legendary French charm

Composition of the fragrance
The initial influx of citrussy freshness from bergamot and lemon soon starts mixing with spicy and woody notes which finally overpower the fruity duo and bring out the oriental character of the fragrance. Later, you’ll notice sweet neroli and mysterious jasmine. The intensity of the entire composition rests on the manly combination of leather and oud wood, underscored by the sweetness of vanilla and exotic patchouli.

Story of the fragrance
In 1965, the masculine Guerlain Habit Rouge became the first modern oriental fragrance for men. Created by Jean-Paul Guerlain as a celebration of horseback riding and dressage. The contrast of the initial freshness with the subsequent ardent sensuality symbolises the control over your own emotions which is so essential in this sport.

As the fragrance reaches its final stages, a masterful blend of patchouli, Haitian vetiver, and musks takes center stage. These captivating base notes leave an addictive and masculine trail, leaving a lasting impression that lingers in the air.

Prada Luna Rossa Ocean is a symphony of contrasting elements, expertly orchestrated to create a fragrance that embodies sophistication, adventure, and sensuality. Gao is part of a prestigious collection dedicated entirely to traditional Arab perfume making, using pure oud distillation. It embodies the spirit of this ancient art form, paying homage to its roots and showcasing the opulence and sophistication that have defined Arab perfumery for centuries.

Embark on a captivating olfactory journey with Xerjoff Alexandria III, a fragrance crafted in collaboration with Kostas, Xerjoff's Brand Ambassador. Inspired by the Orient, this scent is a testament to the rich tradition of Arabian perfumery and the allure of exotic lands.

At the heart of Alexandria III lies the exquisite combination of rare Laotian oud and Bulgarian rose. The deep, smoky and intoxicating aroma of Laotian oud creates a sense of mystery and fascination, transporting you to distant lands and captivating your senses with its alluring presence. The Bulgarian rose adds a touch of elegance and floral sweetness, beautifully harmonizing with the oud to create a truly mesmerizing accord.

The fragrance opens with woody top notes that further enhance the oriental character of Alexandria III. Cinnamon adds warmth and a subtle spiciness, while rosewood and lavender provide a smooth and aromatic touch. These top notes create a captivating introduction to the fragrance, setting the stage for the opulent journey that follows.

Alexandria III is part of the Oud Stars Collection by Xerjoff, which pays tribute to traditional Arab perfumery and showcases the pure distillation of oud. Oud, often referred to as "liquid gold," is one of the most coveted and desirable ingredients in perfumery, known for its depth, complexity, and intoxicating presence. In Alexandria III, the rare Laotian oud takes center stage, enveloping the wearer in its captivating aura and adding an aura of luxury and sophistication.

Indulge in the allure of Xerjoff Alexandria III, a fragrance that captures the essence of the Orient and the timeless beauty of oud and rose. Let its enchanting blend of ingredients transport you to exotic lands and immerse you in a world of indulgence and elegance.

title: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Immerse yourself in the timeless allure of Alexandria II by Xerjoff, a fragrance that pays homage to the ancient Arabian art of perfumery and the rich cultural heritage of the city of Alexandria.

Alexandria II opens with a delightful interplay of fruity hints of apple, adding a touch of sweetness and freshness to the composition. This fruity accord is complemented by the aromatic notes of lavender and the woody nuances of rosewood, creating a captivating and inviting introduction to the fragrance.

As the scent develops, a classically oriental heart unfolds, showcasing the warm and refined notes of cedarwood, lily of the valley, and Bulgarian rose. These floral and woody elements blend harmoniously, evoking a sense of elegance and sophistication. The combination of cedarwood's smoothness, the delicate beauty of lily of the valley, and the timeless allure of Bulgarian rose creates a captivating and captivating heart.

In the base, Alexandria II reveals its true depth and richness. The warming and luxurious notes of amber, sandalwood, and precious Laotian oud take center stage, enveloping the senses in a sensual and opulent embrace. These base notes add depth, complexity, and a touch of oriental allure to the fragrance, lingering on the skin and leaving a lasting impression.

Alexandria II is a fragrance that transports you to a world of ancient perfumery and cultural heritage. It captures the essence of Alexandria, a city steeped in history and tradition, and celebrates the artistry and craftsmanship of Arabian perfumery. Allow yourself to be captivated by the timeless beauty and sophistication of Alexandria II, as it unfolds its layers of fruity, floral, and oriental accords, leaving a trail of warmth and elegance in its wake.

title: Xerjoff Uden Overdose Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Uden Overdose by Xerjoff is a powerful and captivating fragrance that takes the beloved Uden scent to new heights. Inspired by the tempestuous sea, this enchanting fougere fragrance evokes a sense of power, strength, and adventure.


The fragrance opens with an invigorating blend of zesty lemon and bergamot, creating a refreshing and uplifting top note that dances upon the waves of the ocean. The citrus accord adds a bright and energetic quality to the composition, setting the stage for the olfactory journey that awaits.

As the fragrance develops, a dark and intriguing heart emerges. Notes of ginger, tobacco flowers, and coffee come together, adding depth and complexity to the scent. The warmth of ginger, the floral nuances of tobacco flowers, and the aromatic allure of coffee create a captivating blend that entices the senses and adds a touch of mystery to the fragrance.

In the base, Uden Overdose reveals its rich and sensual character. Notes of amber and musk provide a warm and inviting foundation, enveloping the wearer in a comforting and alluring embrace. The combination of these base notes adds a sense of depth, sophistication, and lasting power to the fragrance.

As a tribute to its exceptional nature, Uden Overdose is presented in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of a meteorite, further enhancing its unique and captivating allure.

Uden Overdose is a fragrance that embodies the spirit of adventure, power, and strength. Its rich olfactory pyramid, from the refreshing top notes to the dark and intriguing heart, and the warm and sensual base, creates an olfactory experience that captures the essence of the tempestuous sea and leaves a lasting impression.

title: Xerjoff Shooting Stars Kobe Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Kobe by Xerjoff is a fragrance that exudes intense power and captivates the senses with its luxurious composition. It takes you on an olfactory journey filled with citrus freshness and warm sensuality.

The fragrance opens with a burst of exquisite citrus top notes, prominently featuring bergamot. This citrusy accord immediately uplifts the spirits and creates a refreshing and invigorating sensation. The bright and zesty aroma of bergamot sets the stage for the aromatic experience that follows.

As the scent develops, it unveils an equally enchanting heart composed of neroli, petit grain, and orange flowers. Neroli, derived from the blossoms of bitter orange trees, brings a delicate floral nuance with hints of sweetness. Petit grain, extracted from the leaves and twigs of the same tree, adds a green and aromatic facet to the composition. The orange flowers further enhance the floral bouquet, infusing the fragrance with their captivating and romantic aroma.

The base notes of Kobe create a warm and inviting foundation for the fragrance. Amber, with its rich and resinous character, imparts a sense of depth and complexity. Musk, known for its sensual and comforting qualities, adds a touch of allure and sensuality. Tonka, with its sweet and creamy facets, brings a warm and comforting dimension to the composition, leaving a lasting impression.

What makes Kobe truly special is its luxurious presentation. The fragrance is enthroned in a luxurious case embedded with a certified fragment of a meteorite. This unique touch adds a sense of exclusivity and cosmic allure, making each bottle of Kobe a true collector's item.

Kobe by Xerjoff is a captivating fragrance that combines the freshness of citrus with warm and sensual undertones. Its luxurious composition and the addition of a meteorite fragment make it a truly extraordinary scent, inviting you to experience the intense power it holds. Let Kobe envelop you in its aromatic embrace and take you on a journey of opulence and allure.

In the base, Zefiro unveils its traditional and oriental character. Rich oud, known for its deep and woody aroma, forms the foundation of the fragrance, adding an element of exoticism and intensity. Amber provides warmth and sensuality, enveloping the scent in a comforting embrace.

Zefiro is a fragrance that pays tribute to the inspiring heritage and unrivaled creativity of Italy. Its spicy and oriental character, from the vibrant top notes to the traditional base, captures the essence of Rome's Baroque history and the glamour of the country. Immerse yourself in the mystery and allure of Zefiro and experience the captivating spirit of Italy.

title: Xerjoff Renaissance Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Renaissance by Xerjoff is a fragrance that beautifully captures the essence of Italy, paying homage to its rich heritage and glamorous spirit. This sparkling bouquet of fruity accords invites you to embark on a sensory journey through the vibrant landscapes and captivating beauty of the country.

The fragrance opens with a burst of freshness, as top notes of Calabrian bergamot, mandarin, and lemon enliven the senses. The zesty citrus notes evoke the sun-drenched citrus groves that dot the Italian countryside, filling the air with their invigorating aroma. This uplifting opening sets the stage for the olfactory experience that follows.

In the heart of Renaissance, a captivating blend of Bulgarian rose, mint, and blossoming Lily of the Valley takes center stage. These floral notes represent the exquisite and varied beauty of Italy, from the romantic allure of blooming roses to the delicate freshness of springtime flowers. The combination of floral and minty accords creates a sense of vibrancy and elegance, adding depth and complexity to the composition.

As the fragrance unfolds, warm and classic Xerjoff Renaissance basenotes emerge, leaving a trail of sheer sophistication. Cedarwood brings a woody element, lending a sense of groundedness and stability. Patchouli adds an earthy and aromatic facet, while amber and musk contribute a warm and sensual touch. These base notes create a harmonious blend that lingers on the skin with impeccable delicacy, leaving a lasting impression.

Renaissance is authentically Italian in heart, body, and soul. It embodies the spirit of Italy, from its fresh and vibrant top notes to its warm and inviting basenotes. This fragrance is a sparkling tribute to the country's rich heritage and glamorous allure. Immerse yourself in the splendor of Renaissance and experience the beauty and elegance of Italy.

title: Xerjoff XJ 1861 Decas Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Decas by Xerjoff is a captivating fragrance that commemorates the 10th anniversary of the first perfume in the Xerjoff 1861 collection. This opulent scent evokes an inspiring mood with its intriguing and luxurious composition.


The fragrance opens with a burst of zesty Calabrian mandarin, adding a vibrant and refreshing touch to the top notes. The citrus accord sets the stage for the olfactory journey that unfolds.

As the fragrance develops, a captivating heart emerges. Notes of tuberose and tobacco come together, creating an intriguing and opulent combination. The creamy and floral nuances of tuberose blend harmoniously with the smoky and aromatic qualities of tobacco, adding depth and complexity to the scent. This combination evokes a sense of regality and ceremony, reminiscent of historic Italy.

At the core of Decas, Italian orris and ceremonial benzoin take center stage. The elegant and powdery orris adds a touch of sophistication and refinement, while the rich and resinous benzoin enhances the regal atmosphere of the fragrance. Together, they create a captivating heart that is both alluring and memorable.

In the base, Decas reveals its warmth and sensuality. Smoky opopanax adds a subtle smoldering quality to the composition, while notes of musk, balsam, and vanilla provide a grounding and comforting base. The combination of these base notes adds depth, richness, and a touch of sweetness to the fragrance, ensuring a lasting impression.

Decas is a fragrance that celebrates the heritage and artistry of Xerjoff's 1861 collection. Its luxurious and opulent composition, from the zesty top notes to the regal heart and warm base, creates an olfactory experience that captivates the senses and evokes a sense of grandeur and celebration.

Step into your own heroic narrative with Burberry's latest creation - a scent that embodies the essence of courage and authenticity. Like a bold protagonist in a captivating tale, this fragrance unfolds with the power of warm cedarwood oils, the strength of benzoin, and the invigorating essence of pine needles.

As you wear this fragrance, you become the Hero of your own story. Confident and courageous, you navigate the journey of life with a sense of purpose and authenticity. Just like a compelling tale, your presence captivates those around you, leaving an unforgettable impression wherever you go.

Burberry's latest offering is more than just a scent; it's an invitation to embrace your inner Hero and live your own extraordinary story. Let this fragrance be your constant companion, a reminder of your strength and uniqueness as you create your own narrative of triumph and adventure.

body_html:
Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée, the heat of ice. A new Eau de Parfum, both fresh and intense.

Created by Christine Nagel, Hermès’ perfumer, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée combines the vigour of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d’Hermès.

Refillable and sustainable, the bottle combines glass with aluminium, two fully recyclable materials. As if cut from ice, the object is sleek and limpid. Frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the notion of frost covering the earth. The H on its base is a subtle reference to the ancestry of a now-cult object.

Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new territory where freshness and strength nourish each other. “An icy cloak fertilises the earth, exalting it with new and vibrant strength.” Christine Nagel, creative director of Hermès fragrances.

Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée encapsulates in a bottle two contradictions, two opposites: an icy tremor and generous power. The Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the power of Timut pepper. The Terre d’Hermès collection tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements.

title: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Introducing Hero, the enchanting eau de toilette by Burberry, an ode to strength and compassion, and the visionary creation of Riccardo Tisci, the esteemed designer for the British House. This captivating fragrance is a beautiful paradox, exuding both powerful presence and delicate subtlety.

At its core lies a trio of exquisite cedarwood oils, sourced from three distinct mountain ranges - the Appalachian in Virginia, the majestic Atlas Mountains, and the awe-inspiring Himalayas. This carefully curated blend of cedarwood oils adds depth and richness to the scent, evoking a sense of grounding and empowerment, just like the enduring mountains themselves.

As you embark on this olfactory journey, you are greeted with the invigorating sparkle of bergamot, a burst of bright citrus that awakens your senses and fills you with a zest for life. In harmony with the bergamot, the energizing juniper note takes hold, infusing the fragrance with a spirit of vitality and renewal.

Yet, what truly sets Hero apart is its unique ability to balance strength with compassion. As the scent settles, it reveals a captivating duality that resonates within. The powerful aura it emits is softened by a tender touch of compassion, making it a fragrance that embraces the complexities of the modern hero - one who is both bold and empathetic, strong and caring.

In every spritz, Hero captures the essence of courage and vulnerability, delivering a harmonious symphony of scents that leaves an unforgettable impression. This fragrance is not just a celebration of individuality; it is an invitation to embrace your inner hero, to be proud of your unique journey, and to approach life with unwavering strength and compassion.

Wear Hero with pride, knowing that it symbolizes not only the triumphant spirit of the mountains but also the beauty of embracing one's own contradictions. This fragrance is a tribute to the hero within us all, a reminder that true strength lies not only in might but in the kindness we show to others and ourselves.
